correctness.rationale: Exact two-piece simplicial cover has intersection exactly Q_n. Each piece strongly retracts to a simplex boundary spheres of dimension n minus two. For at least four matched pairs the graph inclusions are nullhomotopic by simple connectivity, yielding a homotopy pushout wedge of two spheres of dimension n minus two and a graph suspension; cycle rank is n squared minus three n plus one. For three matched pairs six free-edge collapses leave C6. In the separated degrees for at least five matched pairs integral natural Mayer--Vietoris proves the module identities, including the minus sign upon swapping cover parts. Oriented graph chain traces yield the explicit formulas. Finite independently constructed mod-two boundary ranks three matched pairs..8 and signed Lefschetz traces five and six matched pairs match; not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Natural canonical symmetric crown family exhibits dense interacting four-cycles beyond sparse-square results. Exact complete homotopy classification introduces two top-degree spheres with unbounded dimension while the degree-two rank grows quadratically. Integral S_n times C2 symmetry modules and explicit traces distinguish the topology beyond Betti tables. The parameter transition is natural and structural, not an arbitrary finite case.
